    Convert tidy_microbiome to S7 Formal Object

    to_s7.Rd

    Coerces an S3 tidy_microbiome object to a next-generation S7 formal object with typed properties and validation contracts.

    Usage

    to_s7(tb)

    Arguments

    tb

    A tidy_microbiome object.

    Value

    A tidybiome::tidy_microbiome_s7 object.

    Examples

    if (requireNamespace("S7", quietly = TRUE)) {
  data(gut_microbiome)
  tb_s7 <- to_s7(gut_microbiome)
  print(tb_s7)
}
